Thinking is switched off per request by reasoning_effort none, which LM Studio maps to the hub model's enableThinking custom field (chat_template_kwargs is ignored; without the hub model.yaml neither works). Usage is reported in the stream; cached prompt tokens are not. LM Studio stops at max_tokens-1 (511 of 512, checked by re-tokenizing the text), so every decode run carries a completion_tokens flag; rates use the reported count. Daemon pid from ~/.lmstudio/.internal/llmster-pid.lock: memory is the whole llmster tree (daemon + node worker hosting the engine). GGUF route: LM Studio's own lmstudio-community Q4_K_M GGUF (16.8 GB) does carry the MTP layer (blk.64.nextn) and the llama.cpp runtime 2.60.0 (b11698) can draft with it (--speculative-draft-mtp); it was not measured inside LM Studio because the 16.8 GB download no longer fit the 10 GB disk reserve while other jobs were writing (free fell 31 -> 25 GB during its first 2 GB; aborted and deleted). Standalone llama.cpp b11669 on the same quant: MTP n-max 3 18.3 tok/s (plain 10.0), prefill 84/77 tok/s, 30.6 GB peak.
